stories.title: CTO architecture decisions: web telemetry (Option A) + OTel strategy (Option 1)

decisions.decision: Option A — Keep Error Authority for web
decisions.rationale: Web app uses captureNextServerError → /error-authority/ingest → Postgres. Adding @sentry/nextjs would introduce a second PII review surface with no v1 benefit. Revisit when multi-service distributed tracing is required.

decisions.decision: Option 1 — Sentry Performance only, no separate OTel collector
decisions.rationale: tracesSampleRate: 0.1 already set in production. No OTLP endpoint needed for v1. Revisit when team exceeds 3 Railway services or requires vendor-neutral trace export.

decisions.decision: Vexa Error Authority is canonical. External vendors are optional sinks only.
decisions.rationale: Vexa already has error grouping, occurrences, sanitized context, release correlation, and admin UI. Adding Sentry duplicates a capability Vexa owns. No external dependency required for correctness, error visibility, or incident handling. See ADR-001.

acceptance: Web telemetry decision documented: Error Authority retained, no @sentry/nextjs for v1
OTel decision documented: Sentry Performance only, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT not set for v1
Vexa Observability Authority principle documented in ADR-001
